biggest_catch: Study availability is entirely demographic- and prescreener-dependent — you only earn when studies match your profile; there is no guaranteed volume and screen-outs pay nothing.
catches: You are paid only for completed studies; screen-outs and rejected submissions pay nothing.
Study volume depends on your demographics, location, and prescreener answers — some participants see few studies.
The £6/$8 minimum and £9/$12 recommendation are researcher-facing policy, not a promise of hours.
Cash out via PayPal; minimum payout threshold was not confirmed on official pages in this research — do not assume.

c1.evidence: Prolific — real operating research-participant platform; official domain prolific.com.

c2.evidence: Official Prolific researcher policy (wellbeing/policy page) sets a minimum participant rate of £6/$8 per hour and recommends £9/$12 per hour.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to join as a participant.

c4.evidence: Concrete official floor: £6/$8 per hour minimum, £9/$12 per hour recommended, per completed study.

eligibility: 18+; participant account with identity verification; study-specific demographic prescreeners decide which studies you are offered.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 from official Prolific policy pages (researcher-facing wellbeing/policy page stating the £6/$8 minimum and £9/$12 recommendation). This is variable gig work: the rate floor is real, but volume is demographic-dependent and unpaid screen-outs are the honest reality. Do not present as guaranteed hourly income. Minimum cash-out threshold not confirmed officially — left unquoted.
payout_quote: Prolific's researcher policy requires participants to be paid a minimum of £6/$8 per hour and recommends £9/$12 per hour. (Substance of the official Prolific wellbeing/policy page.)

s2.note: Unpaid screen-outs; pay only for completed studies; volume is demographic-dependent.

s3.note: Paid per completed study; cash out via PayPal.

s4.note: Rate floor stated plainly in official policy; the variability caveat is the catch, not weasel wording.

s5.note: https://www.prolific.com/ — official domain; rate policy on official pages.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: sign up, verify identity, complete prescreeners, take matched studies, cash out.

steps: Go to https://www.prolific.com/ and sign up as a participant.
Verify your identity as required by the platform.
Complete your demographic prescreeners honestly — these decide which studies you are offered.
Watch for study invitations matched to your profile and complete them carefully.
Get paid per completed study at the posted rate (floor £6/$8 per hour); cash out via PayPal.
timing: Paid per completed study; cash out via PayPal.
